title: Quick Rice Noodle and Green Bean Stir-Fry
subtitle: with soy, maple and sesame
description: Thin rice noodles stir-fried with green beans and garlic in a soy and maple sauce, finished with toasted sesame seeds and sesame oil.

steps.text: Place the frozen green beans in a colander and rinse under warm tap water for 2 minutes to thaw the ice.
Place the rice noodles in a bowl and cover with boiling water. Cover the bowl and leave for 5-10 minutes until the noodles are completely soft. Drain.
Heat the oil in a pan, add the sliced garlic and green beans and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes, until the garlic turns golden.
In a small bowl mix the soy sauce and maple syrup and add to the pan. Add the noodles and stir-fry everything together until evenly mixed. Taste and add a little salt if needed. Remove from the heat.
Add the sesame seeds and a few drops of sesame oil, mix and serve.
